`"Unrecognized client_id"` means the OAuth login request from the Supabase plugin is being rejected by the auth provider (usually stale/outdated plugin auth config).

Try this sequence:

- Update Cursor to latest version.
- Remove and reinstall the Supabase plugin.
- Fully restart Cursor (not just window reload).
- Retry authentication from the plugin prompt.
- If it still fails, it’s likely a plugin-side OAuth config issue (not your project), so report it to Cursor/Supabase plugin support with the exact error text.

If you want, I can immediately retry the `mcp_auth` flow once after your restart and confirm whether it succeeds.
